```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(scales)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(stringr)

library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(webshot2)
```

```{r}
#| label: data
#| include: false
icdver <- read_xlsx("DataFiles/2019-icd10-cm.xlsx")
opd_dx1_poly <- read_csv("DataFiles/Database_Registers/Data_Warehouse/OPD_Diagnoses/2026-JAN-SEP_OPD-CONDITIONS-TTH.csv") |> filter(department=="Poly Clinic") |> 
  mutate(
  code = trimws(icd10_code, which = "both"),
    icd10_code2 = recode(
      icd10_code,
      "I64"=	"I639", "I500" = "I509", "V5849" =	"Z4889", "A099" =	"A09", "Z2251"	= "Z228",

      "E141" =	"E131","N3590"	= "N359","X791"	= "X79","A090"	= "A09","H4011X3"	= "H4010X3",
      "O822"	= "Z9071", "NI82" =	"N182", "M841"	= "M8430XP", "O756" =	"O75", "KO55"	= "K055",
      "I849" = "K649","k053"="K053", "S027" = "S026", "C536" = "N879", "H4011X1"="H401191",
      "Z225" = "Z228","k055" = "K0530","G419" = "G459",  "H4011X2"="H401191",

```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-jan

dx_name_jan <- opd_dx1_poly_icd10 |>
  filter(dx_month == "Jan") |>
  filter(!is.na(disease_name)) |>
  group_by(disease_name) |>
  summarise(N = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(N)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  select(disease_name, N)

table1 <- flextable(dx_name_jan) |>
  set_header_labels(
    disease_name = "Major Disease Name/ICD-10",
    N = "Frequency"
  ) |>
  autofit()
```

```{r}
  slice_max(n = 10, order_by = N, with_ties = TRUE) |>
  select(disease_name, N)

ipd_table_sep <- flextable(ipd_dx_name_sp01_sep) |>
  set_header_labels(
    disease_name = "Disease Sub-Group/ICD-10",
    N = "Frequency"
  ) |>
  autofit()
```
